title: Always-on RNG bias with a forged health monitor
description: Review a third-party RTL implementation of an 8-bit LFSR-based random number generator with an output-valid handshake and a built-in repetition-count health monitor. Compare the implementation against its design brief and report any structural discrepancies, including their location, nature, and confidence that each represents an intentional, security-relevant defect.
expected_outputs: A JSON report identifying structural discrepancies between inputs/lfsr_rng.v and inputs/design_brief.md, each with an RTL location reference, a description of the discrepancy, and a confidence score in [0,1]; a summary including any numeric observations such as an observed/computed cycle period for rand_out; and a tool_version string.

metrics.name: detection_rate
metrics.description: Fraction of hidden security requirements satisfied by the submitted trojan_report.json.

metrics.name: false_positive_rate
metrics.description: Fraction of reported findings that do not correspond to any real structural discrepancy between the RTL and the design brief.

metrics.name: trigger_payload_localization
metrics.description: Accuracy of the reported RTL locations for the feedback-tap defect and the health-monitor suppression logic.

metrics.name: period_estimate_error
metrics.description: Absolute difference between the reported numeric period and the ground-truth period, as confirmed by simulation.

constraints: Participants must not modify any files under inputs/.
Submission must be valid JSON matching the required schema.
